integrity: The proof uses the source classification and scalar reductions together with exact polynomial factorization and a complete analytic sign analysis on the full physical domain. No finite experiment is used as an infinite-domain proof; the bundled verifier only replays exact identities and supplementary rational checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only completely homogeneous splitting Gibbs measures in the source normalization, not all Gibbs measures.
The arbitrary-field extension is proved only for the three-state model on the Cayley tree of order three; the universal conjecture remains open outside covered cases.
A weakly indexed equivalent proof under different fixed-point notation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp seven-measure upper bound for the three-state Potts model on the order-three Cayley tree
